target_problem: exact polynomial-time evaluation of the V92 canonical halving trajectory for NC0_3-Avoid[N,N+1]
conditional_implication: If the exact V92 canonical halving word were computable in deterministic polynomial time for every stretch-one NC0_3 circuit, then the PP-complete comparison COMPARE-#3SAT_<= would be in P, so P=PP and therefore P=NP. V95 proves this implication by a genuinely canonical balanced-definition compiler. No such implication is proved for finding an arbitrary avoided output.
frontier_reason: The result closes the exact canonical-halving strategy as a plausible generic polynomial route unless P=PP, but does not improve the all-instance avoidance runtime or trigger a published lower-bound transfer from arbitrary range avoidance.

bridge_lemmas.name: fresh BALDEF_f(z,a,b)=z XOR f(a,b) has exactly equal zero/one children under every prior prefix independent of z
topologically ordered balanced definitions compose into a genuinely canonical all-zero loader with unique source extensions
two 3-CNF truth values can be loaded using only four signed-OR definition types and one AND definition type
the ternary selector gate has child counts A+2^n-B and 2^n-A+B after the canonical loader
the specified next canonical bit equals the PP-complete comparison #sat(F0)<=#sat(F1)
the compiler preserves maximum locality three and exact stretch M=N+1
computing an arbitrary avoided output requires reproducing the V92 canonical word
NC0_3-Avoid[N,N+1] is PP-hard as a total search problem

current_gap: The exact canonical path is now blocked by a PP-hardness theorem, but range avoidance is a total search problem with many valid outputs. The surviving route is to find a different absent word using information strictly weaker than exact child comparison/canonical reproduction.
result_obtained: A composable balanced-definition canonicalization lemma and a fixed seven-gate locality-three, stretch-one compiler whose genuinely canonical next bit is PP-hard; exhaustive primary/independent finite audits support the implementation.
closed_route: generic polynomial-time acceleration of the exact V92 minority/tie-zero canonical halving word
surviving_route: comparison-free range avoidance: zero detection, one-sided certificates, coarse estimates, target lists, or a different deterministic output policy
stop_rule: Do not spend V96 trying to compute the same exact V92 canonical word faster. Any V96 candidate must construct a different avoided output or prove a theorem about weaker-than-comparison information sufficient for avoidance.
